human_decision.note: Too little detail. Ask for the order number and what went wrong.

message: This is the third time I'm writing. Nobody answers. Just fix it.

human_decision.note: Frustrated repeat contact with no details. Apologise, ask for the original ticket or order number.

message: Your site took my money but the page crashed and now I can't see any order. I want it back or the order placed, whichever is faster.

human_decision.note: Likely a payment captured without an order. Check the payment log before offering a refund.

message: The discount code didn't apply so I paid full price. Can I get the difference back, or do I have to return the item and reorder?
note: Written as ambiguous, but the classifier's category definitions list price adjustments under billing, so it routes directly (0.94 on the first run).

message: Two things: the app told me my payment failed but my bank shows the charge, and I also want to return the shoes from my last order.

human_decision.note: Handle the possible double charge first; tell the customer a separate return request will follow.
